short_description: Husfeld et al. (1989) NLTE H-He atmospheres for hot helium-rich stars, Teff 35-80 kK (SVO Husfeld)
description: SVO's "Husfeld et al models for non-LTE Helium-rich stars": NLTE hydrogen-helium model atmospheres (Husfeld, Butler, Heber & Drilling 1989), Teff 35,000-80,000 K, log g 4.0-7.0, helium abundance Y(He) 0, 0.01, 0.10, 0.25, 0.35, 0.50 and 0.70. There is no metallicity axis: each Y(He) value is a variant with its own MESA cube.

default_variant_note: flux_cube.bin at the top level is a byte copy of this variant's cube, for clients that read only the top-level cube: SED_Tools 0.4.1's SED.local, tested on 30 Oct 2026 (whether MESA colors reads it was not tested). Y(He) = 0.10 is a choice, not a fact of the grid: it is the value nearest the solar helium abundance by number (about 0.09), but SVO's page says only 'value for the Helium abundance', not whether Y(He) is a number or a mass fraction (by mass the nearest would be 0.25). Nill to confirm. The top-level cube served before 29 Oct 2026 was empty.
